page.overview:
Who is Australian Bartender?

The Australian Bartender is an employee of the Pub in Australia. He gives Homer Simpson a huge can of the Foster Big Lager, though Homer is disappointed by its size. Marge Simpson repeatedly asks for coffee, but he fails to understand her request and instead attempts to give her beer.
